summary: One parish of three churches (Immaculate Conception Hoosick Falls, Holy Cross Salem, St. Patrick's Cambridge). Weekend and weekday Masses, Saturday confession and the first-Monday Adoration are printed identically in all five bulletins; the Adoration has no clock time, so it is set at 9:30 AM by POLICY's rule for after a weekday Mass. No open questions.
